collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.before: one villager who walks with crutches falls
ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A group sets out for the far beach, and one villager who walks with crutches falls behind on the sandy path.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A group sets out for the far beach, and (name1), who walks with crutches, falls behind on the sandy path.

choices.label: Ask How They Would Like to Travel.
Walk at Their Pace with Them.
Lay Woven Mats Over the Softest Sand.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager suggests a firmer route along the tree line, and everyone takes it.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The villager says they prefer their own pace and will meet the group there, and the group trusts them.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A couple of friends drop back and enjoy a slower, chattier walk.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The villager finds the company kind but would rather walk alone, and says so.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The whole group enjoys a long break under the palms.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The rest makes them late, and they arrive just in time for sunset.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The mats make the path easier for everyone, including children carrying baskets.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The mats slide around in the wind, and the group gives up laughing.
